title: Measurement of Trans-Epithelial Electrical Resistance with EVOM2 and Chopstick Electrode
protocol: Sterilize and soak probe in cell culture medium.
Add 1 mL of cell culture medium to the apical side of each 24 mm Transwell insert.
Add 500 μL of cell culture medium to the apical side of each 12 mm Transwell insert.
Connect the electrode to the meter by inserting the RJ plug into the Input port on the meter.
Set the Function switch to Ohms and turn the Power on (I).
Place the electrode in a blank insert with cell media in the basal compartment and PBS in the apical compartment to measure the blank resistance.
Insert the electrode into the blank cup to obtain a steady reading of the solution resistance.
Measure the blank resistance.
Take three resistance readings per insert.
Subtract the blank resistance from each reading to obtain the tissue resistance value.
Clean and store the electrode dry when finished.
Rinse the electrode with distilled water and dry it.
Make a 1% solution of Tergazyme according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Suspend the tips of the electrodes in the Tergazyme solution, fully immersing them.
Soak overnight if not cleaned regularly.
Soak for 30–60 minutes if on a weekly cleaning schedule.
Soak for 5 minutes if on a daily cleaning schedule.
Rinse well with distilled or de-ionized water after soaking.
Allow electrode to air dry and store dry away from sunlight.
Resurface the probe occasionally by lightly sanding with 600-grit ultra-fine sandpaper.
